text: Arslan Ghani holds account PK**HABB****1319 opened on 3 March 2025. The subject is a Student with a declared monthly income of PKR 20,000 per month. Between 2 May 2026 and 11 May 2026 the account received 16 credits totalling PKR 960,000 and made 4 debits totalling PKR 847,000. All 16 credits were interbank (IBFT) transfers from 13 distinct senders. An alert was raised by Tazama on 11 May 2026 after the typology MULE-01 scored 360 against a threshold of 300. Taken together, the activity is consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 572,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 2 transactions. PKR 275,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 2 transactions. Screening on 29 May 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media. L2 analyst placed outgoing wallet transfers on hold pending review, with no contact made with the customer.
